On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], the native [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] maintained an '''airbase''' that served as a supply line to the planet's [[Umbaran capital city/Legends|capital]]. During the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] commanded by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] took over the airbase after [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] and [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] were able to obtain [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]] and clear the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] path to the airbase. It then served as the command center for [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].

After Fives, [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] and Hardcase took starfighters to destroy a [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|supply ship]], Fives and Jesse were held prisoner in the prison cells by General Krell for disobeying his command.

Krell was executed here after it was discovered he was sabotaging the Republic's efforts on Umbara.
